{"id":1934299874,"question_id":4161,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772335392,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1934299874/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Bitwise OR From Grid","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool ispossible(vector<vector<int>>& grid , int mid)\n    {\n        for(auto &it : grid){\n            bool found = false;\n            for(auto val : it){\n                if((val | mid) == mid){\n                    found = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            if(!found) return false;\n        }\n    return true;\n    }\n    \n    int minimumOR(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        int s = 0;\n        int e = 0;\n        for(auto &it : grid){\n            for(auto val : it){\n                e |= val;\n            }\n        }\n        int ans = -1;\n\n        while(s <= e){\n            int mid = s + (e-s)/2;\n            if(ispossible(grid , mid))\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                e = mid - 1;\n            }\n            else s = mid + 1;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-bitwise-or-from-grid","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1758}
